definition: Daniela Amodei (born 1987) is an American entrepreneur and the president of Anthropic, an artificial intelligence (AI) company known for its Claude series of large language models.
details: She co-founded Anthropic in 2021 with her brother Dario Amodei. Prior to her work at Anthropic, she was the vice president of safety and policy at OpenAI.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. The idea is simple: before something powerful is let loose, someone checks that it will not do real harm to real people. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. And that is Daniela Amodei — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
